The '''Vagaari Wars''' were a series of conflicts,<ref name="CSWE" /> including the [[Third Vagaari War]],<ref name="Joiner King" /> that were fought between the [[Vagaari Empire]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="CSWE" />

{{Chiss-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They and their deeds have not been seen for many years. Not since the battle where the Outbound Flight was destroyed, in fact.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
While the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' mentions that the Vagaari Wars happened after [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' makes it clear that the Chiss have not seen the Vagaari since the time of the [[Outbound Flight Project]]<ref name="SQ" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OF date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> which would place the first and second of the Vagaari Wars prior to 27 BBY.
